info.name: Hospigo 7e pictures
info.description: Step 7e (API): the hospital logo and the doctor signature or stamp picture. BEFORE RUNNING: (1) npm run prisma:migrate -w @hospigo/api  (2) restart the API on port 3000. Select the Hospigo Local environment (staffPassword and superadminPassword), then Run collection. The pictures are a 30-byte WebP written as text in the request body (every byte is a plain character), so no file has to be chosen. The collection expects the demo hospital to have NO logo and no doctor signature yet, and removes what it makes. Nothing is deleted: the pictures it uploads stay on record (this is by design) and the files stay in the storage folder. About 4 logins count against the login IP limit (20 per minute).

item.name: 0 Setup
O1 Login Indigo Owner (no access code)
O2 The Owner sees the hospitals and picks Demo North
O3 Enter Demo North as the Indigo Owner
1 Login SuperAdmin (north)

exec: pm.test('select the Hospigo Local environment: staffPassword and superadminPassword must be set', () => { pm.expect(pm.variables.get('staffPassword'), 'staffPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(pm.variables.get('superadminPassword'), 'superadminPassword').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: 2 Login Receptionist (north main)
3 Login Doctor North 3
4 Login SuperAdmin (south)
1 Hospital logo
5 No token = 401
6 Anyone signed in can ask what the logo is; the demo hospital has none yet

exec: pm.test('the logo is null or a logo object (logos cannot be deleted, so a demo hospital may already have one)', () => { if (j.logo !== null) { pm.expect(j.logo).to.be.an('object'); } });

pm.test('the receptionist may not change it; the limits are sent', () => { pm.expect(j.canWrite).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.limits.maxBytes).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.limits.types).to.include('image/png'); });

item.name: 7 The Indigo Owner may change it
8 The receptionist cannot upload a logo (403)

body.raw:
--pm7e
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="logo.webp"
Content-Type: image/webp

RIFF���WEBPVP8X
�������?��?��
--pm7e--

item.name: 9 The receptionist cannot remove the logo (403)
10 No file at all is refused (REQUIRED)

exec: pm.test('refused with the field and the reason', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('SETTINGS_INVALID'); pm.expect(j.field).to.eql('file'); pm.expect(j.reason).to.eql('REQUIRED'); });

item.name: 11 A text file with a .png name is refused (NOT_AN_IMAGE): the bytes decide, not the name

body.raw:
--pm7e
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="logo.png"
Content-Type: image/png

this is only some text, not a picture
--pm7e--

exec: pm.test('refused with the field and the reason', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('SETTINGS_INVALID'); pm.expect(j.field).to.eql('file'); pm.expect(j.reason).to.eql('NOT_AN_IMAGE'); });

item.name: 12 An SVG (it can carry scripts) is refused

body.raw:
--pm7e
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="logo.png"
Content-Type: image/png

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><script>alert(1)</script></svg>
--pm7e--

exec: pm.test('refused with the field and the reason', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('SETTINGS_INVALID'); pm.expect(j.field).to.eql('file'); pm.expect(j.reason).to.eql('NOT_AN_IMAGE'); });

item.name: 14 A JSON body instead of a file is refused
15 SuperAdmin uploads a tiny logo

body.raw:
--pm7e
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="logo.webp"
Content-Type: image/webp

RIFF���WEBPVP8X
�������?��?��
--pm7e--

exec: pm.test('judged by its bytes, and only what a screen needs is told', () => { pm.expect(j.contentType).to.eql('image/webp'); pm.expect(j.width).to.eql(64); pm.expect(j.height).to.eql(64); pm.expect(j.byteSize).to.eql(30); pm.expect(Object.keys(j).sort()).to.eql(['byteSize','contentType','createdAt','height','id','width']); });

item.name: 16 The branding answer now carries it
17 Anyone signed in can fetch the logo bytes, as a picture only

exec: pm.test('right type, never run as anything else', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.eql('image/webp'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Content-Type-Options')).to.eql('nosniff'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.eql('inline'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Security-Policy')).to.include("default-src 'none'"); });

item.name: 18 No token on the picture = 401
19 The other hospital cannot see it (404)
20 An unknown or junk id is 404, never a file path
2 Doctor signature or stamp
21 A doctor reads their own profile: no signature yet

exec: pm.test('limits are sent and, in this demo, no picture yet', () => { pm.expect(j.images.maxBytes).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(j.signature).to.eql(null); });

exec: pm.test('refused with the field and the reason', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('SETTINGS_INVALID'); pm.expect(j.field).to.eql('file'); pm.expect(j.reason).to.eql('NOT_AN_IMAGE'); });

item.name: 25 The doctor can look at it
26 SuperAdmin sees it in the doctors list

exec: pm.test('the doctor has a signature picture', () => { const d = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('dId')); pm.expect(d.signature.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('sigId')); });

exec: pm.test('a new current picture; the old one is still on record', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.signature.id).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('sigId')); });

item.name: 31 The first picture can still be fetched (a printed prescription may point at it)
32 The doctor still sees only the newest as current
3 Put things back (nothing is deleted; the pictures stay on record)
33 SuperAdmin removes the doctor signature
34 Removing again is harmless
35 SuperAdmin removes the logo
36 The branding answer has no logo again
37 The old logo can still be fetched (history is kept)
